name: Last Call's Dance
source:
You play as a freshly employed ornithologist (bird enjoyer) but to your shock, your high school rival suddenly wants to meet. 

His name is Lyric Wendel. The only other self proclaimed ornithologist that you've known in your youth. He's kept the same traits that you've grown annoyed by, but something feels off about him. You sense that there's something he's hiding---a deep sadness beneath his mask. While he commends you on your successes, he only mentions how it's his last day in town.

You can’t shake the feeling there's more behind his sudden plea to meet for the last time. Do you find out what he's hiding, or do you let your rivalry simmer down once and for all?

[Edited from [url=https://ocreatus.itch.io/last-calls-dance]itch.io[/url]]
